name: Utano
text: Utano (菟田野町, Utano-chō) was a town located in Uda District, Nara Prefecture, Japan. As of 2005, the town had an estimated population of 4,746 and a density of 170.84 persons per km2. The total area was 27.78 km2.

depictions.name: Utano
depictions.text: Utano, Nara Utano was a town in southeastern Yamato, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the town while in the province. While there, they found a small watchtower, climbed to the top, and oversaw the province.
